tests: the .git carve-out permits the ref surface and refuses hooks, config and info

consumesExternalOutput.program: git, through a real fetch and a real merge --ff-only in a real clone; the permitted set is the set of paths that run actually created or rewrote under .git
consumesExternalOutput.provenance: The allowlist was derived by snapshotting a clone's .git, running git fetch and git merge --ff-only, and diffing, rather than from a memory of what a ref update touches. The standing wide-enough proof is the sibling test 'a real git merge --ff-only moves the ref and the block permits every path it wrote', which selects on the FIRST SEGMENT and not on the predicate under test.
